messages:
tess: quick flag after playing with the new midnight surface 90
legend shadows feel heavy on small charts. they create a floating card effect that competes with series ink. can we try a 2px y-offset + 4px blur at 6% instead of current 12%?

niko: agreed. the current shadow makes legends look like separate UI elements. 2px/4px@6% should be subtle enough. also noticed inline code bg in alerts is slightly greener than console code; feels inconsistent when switching tabs.

priya: good catch on code bg. we should sync tokens so inline code uses `token.code.bg` everywhere. tiny copy nit too: alert header reads "Recent errors" 1 -> "Recent errors (last 24h)" so it's clear on dashboards with range selectors.

theme-bot: pushed token update draft: `tokens/midnight-v5.json`
- legend.shadow: y=2px blur=4px color=#000000 @6%
- code.bg: #0c0e10 (unified)
- series.primary: #56e2b9 @70%

priya: thanks 7a. a11y-bot, can you run a quick contrast on unified code.bg vs panel bg and also legend shadow accessibility concern?

a11y-bot: running checks...
- code.bg (#0c0e10) vs panel bg (#070809): 4.9:1 705 (passes)
- legend text small (11px) on top of shadowed legend bg: 4.2:1 6a0 (below 4.5)
Note: shadows do not affect contrast calculations; the perceived separation might help sighted users but not meet numeric thresholds for small text. Recommendation: increase legend swatch size to 10px or bump text weight +100.

tess: i'd prefer increasing swatch size to 10px, avoids weight changes. niko can you update the compact chart layout?

niko: will do. also propose we add a subtle 1px top hairline to legends (very transparent) to anchor them to the panel instead of floating. think that plus reduced shadow will feel grounded.

priya: sounds good. niko, can you mock both (swatch + hairline) and attach screenshots? we'll test on staging. i'll update the alert header copy in the copy branch.

theme-bot: uploaded figma frame: /design/midnight-legends-v2 with swatch=10px, hairline `#ffffff @4%`, shadow adjusted. token PR created: #340.

priya: last micro: syntax token for boolean values is very bright teal and draws attention in long query snippets. can we desaturate booleans by ~12% so strings remain primary focal points?

niko: makes sense. i'll try boolean -> `#2fc9a0` desat -12% and run contrast.

(a11y-bot runs on the updated tokens)
a11y-bot: re-checking...
- boolean token (#2fc9a0) vs panel bg: 4.3:1 6a0 (still slightly under for very small text)
- boolean token vs code.bg: 2.1:1 (ok for code tokenization)
Recommendation: desaturate only 8% instead of 12% to hit ~4.6:1.

niko: will adjust to -8% and push token update.

priya: perfect. plan: niko updates figma + token PR, tess will QA on mobile low-brightness, theme-bot will land tokens after a11y-bot passes. thanks! :sparkles: (attachments: figma_midnight_legends_v2.png, token-pr-340.diff)
